verdict.rationale: Bevy explicitly lists Web as a supported platform and provides live WASM+WebGL examples runnable in-browser, showing a working browser export path (bevy-docs-6, bevy-docs-16, bevy-docs-34), and community interest in web/mobile support is noted (bevy-comm-20). However there is no evidence addressing WebGPU readiness, payload size/optimization, or load-time concerns that a web developer would care about. Missing for 10: WebGPU backend status/roadmap, payload size benchmarks or optimization guidance, independent hands-on reports of browser deployment quality.
